rules.title: Interactive control meets minimum touch target size
rules.description: Apple recommends a minimum interactive touch target of 44x44 points. When an interactive control's width/height is an explicit, statically-parsed fixed literal below that threshold, this is a directly provable fact about the source, not an inference about rendered size.
required_evidence: explicit fixed width/height literal on an interactive control
rules.confidence_policy: HIGH when an explicit fixed-size literal is parsed directly from source; UNKNOWN when no explicit size is present -- rendered size is never inferred.

rules.title: Icon-only interactive control has an accessible label
rules.description: An icon-only interactive control (no visible text) should carry an accessible label (tooltip/semanticLabel/Semantics) so assistive technologies can describe it.
required_evidence: absence of tooltip/semanticLabel/Semantics within a bounded window
rules.confidence_policy: HIGH when both the icon-only construct and the absence of a label are directly parsed within a bounded, deterministic window; never inferred from prose.

rules.title: Hardcoded font size may resist Dynamic Type scaling
rules.description: A hardcoded fontSize with no accompanying text-scaling API usage in the same file is a heuristic risk signal, not proof that Dynamic Type is unsupported.
required_evidence: absence of text-scaling API usage in file
rules.confidence_policy: MEDIUM at most; a heuristic text match is never escalated to BLOCKED.

rules.title: Safe-area handling evidence
rules.description: Whether a screen actually renders inside the safe area cannot be determined from source alone; SafeArea usage is bridged as evidence only. Its absence is UNKNOWN, never an automatic BLOCKED finding.
required_evidence: SafeArea usage in the same file as a Scaffold
rules.confidence_policy: HIGH when SafeArea usage is found locally; UNKNOWN otherwise, never inferred as a violation.

rules.title: Hardcoded full-screen-like dimensions risk breaking size classes
rules.description: A Container/SizedBox with a fixed width and height matching a specific device's screen dimensions is a heuristic risk signal for layouts that may not adapt across size classes.
required_evidence: fixed width+height literal pair matching a known device screen size
rules.confidence_policy: MEDIUM at most; a heuristic text match is never escalated to BLOCKED.

rules.title: Hardcoded user-visible string
rules.description: A string literal passed directly to a user-visible text widget, with no localization delegate/call in the same expression, is a heuristic risk signal for missing localization -- never proof, since some literals are intentionally non-localized (e.g. debug/log text).
required_evidence: string literal passed to a user-visible text widget
rules.confidence_policy: MEDIUM at most; a heuristic text match is never escalated to BLOCKED.

rules.title: Localization key missing from one language's resource file
rules.description: When two or more localization resource files are found locally and a key present in one is absent from another, this is a directly parsed, deterministic fact.
required_evidence: two or more parsed localization resource files with a key-set difference
rules.confidence_policy: HIGH: derived directly from parsed local resource files, never inferred.

rules.title: Fixed-width text container is a localization/layout risk
rules.description: Text inside a container with a small, fixed literal width risks clipping once translated into a longer-running language; this is a heuristic risk signal only.
required_evidence: small fixed width literal on a container wrapping a text widget
rules.confidence_policy: MEDIUM at most; a heuristic text match is never escalated to BLOCKED.

rules.title: Gesture-only interaction with no discoverable alternative
rules.description: A bare gesture-detection wrapper with no accessibility affordance (Semantics/button role) nearby is a heuristic risk signal for a gesture-only interaction with no discoverable alternative.
required_evidence: gesture-detection construct with no accessibility affordance in a bounded window
rules.confidence_policy: MEDIUM at most; a heuristic text match is never escalated to BLOCKED.

rules.title: Permission request without visible preceding explanatory context
rules.description: A permission-request API call with no explanatory dialog/text construct in a bounded preceding window is a heuristic risk signal, not proof that no context is ever shown to the user.
required_evidence: permission-request API call with no dialog/text construct in a bounded preceding window
rules.confidence_policy: MEDIUM at most; a heuristic text match is never escalated to BLOCKED.

future_sources.note: Reserved for a future phase that ingests actual rendered-UI or screenshot evidence (via --design-evidence) to resolve UNKNOWN findings that require runtime/visual proof. No active Phase 5 rule claims screenshot or OCR coverage.
